<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

defined('ABSPATH') || exit;

// The sandbox suppresses mail, so customers choose a password at registration.
update_option('woocommerce_enable_myaccount_registration', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_registration_generate_password', 'no');

if (get_option('top_pariks_test_seeded')) {
    return;
}

update_option('blog_public', '0');
update_option('woocommerce_default_country', 'US:CA');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'USD');
update_option('woocommerce_enable_guest_checkout', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_calc_taxes', 'no');
update_option('woocommerce_ship_to_countries', 'disabled');
update_option('woocommerce_cod_settings', [
    'enabled' => 'yes',
    'title' => 'Test only — offline payment',
    'description' => 'Demo checkout. No payment will be collected.',
    'instructions' => 'Test order only. Do not send payment.',
    'enable_for_virtual' => 'yes',
]);

WC_Install::create_pages();
foreach (['cart' => '[woocommerce_cart]', 'checkout' => '[woocommerce_checkout]'] as $page => $shortcode) {
    $page_id = wc_get_page_id($page);
    if ($page_id <= 0) {
        throw new RuntimeException("Missing WooCommerce page: $page");
    }

    $updated = wp_update_post(['ID' => $page_id, 'post_content' => $shortcode], true);
    if (is_wp_error($updated)) {
        throw new RuntimeException($updated->get_error_message());
    }
}

$categories = [
    'natural-wigs' => 'ТЕСТ — натуральные парики',
    'synthetic-wigs' => 'ТЕСТ — синтетические парики',
    'short-wigs' => 'ТЕСТ — короткие парики',
    'long-wigs' => 'ТЕСТ — длинные парики',
];
$category_ids = [];
foreach ($categories as $slug => $label) {
    $term = term_exists($slug, 'product_cat') ?: wp_insert_term($label, 'product_cat', ['slug' => $slug]);
    if (is_wp_error($term)) {
        throw new RuntimeException($term->get_error_message());
    }

    $category_ids[$slug] = (int) $term['term_id'];
}

$fixtures = [
    ['TOPQA-NATURAL', 'ТЕСТ — модель Atelier', '19.00', ['natural-wigs', 'long-wigs']],
    ['TOPQA-SYNTHETIC', 'ТЕСТ — модель Studio', '11.00', ['synthetic-wigs', 'short-wigs']],
];
foreach ($fixtures as [$sku, $name, $price, $slugs]) {
    $existing_id = wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku);
    $product = new WC_Product_Simple($existing_id ?: 0);
    $product->set_sku($sku);
    $product->set_name($name);
    $product->set_slug(strtolower($sku));
    $product->set_regular_price($price);
    $product->set_status('publish');
    $product->set_virtual(true);
    $product->set_category_ids(array_map(static function ($slug) use ($category_ids) {
        return $category_ids[$slug];
    }, $slugs));
    $product->save();
}

flush_rewrite_rules();
update_option('top_pariks_test_seeded', '1');


$result = tp_provision_storefront();
if (is_wp_error($result)) {
    throw new RuntimeException($result->get_error_message());
}
$product = wc_get_product(wc_get_product_id_by_sku('TOPQA-NATURAL'));
$product->set_featured(true);
$product->save();
update_option('blogname', 'TOP-PARIKS · Тестовая витрина');

foreach (['delivery', 'contacts'] as $slug) {
    $page = get_page_by_path($slug);
    if ($page) {
        wp_update_post(['ID' => $page->ID, 'post_content' => 'Тестовая витрина TOP-PARIKS. Покупки и обслуживание заказов на этом стенде недоступны.']);
    }
}

<?php require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
defined('ABSPATH') || exit;

// This isolated store must be accessible to guests.
update_option('woocommerce_coming_soon', 'no');

foreach ([
    'material' => ['Материал', ['Натуральные волосы', 'Искусственное волокно']],
    'length' => ['Длина', ['Длинные', 'Короткие']],
    'color' => ['Цвет', ['Каштановый', 'Тёмно-русый']],
    'size' => ['Размер', ['M', 'S']],
] as $slug => [$label, $values]) {
    $id = wc_attribute_taxonomy_id_by_name($slug);
    if (!$id) {
        $id = wc_create_attribute(['name' => $label, 'slug' => $slug]);
        if (is_wp_error($id)) {
            throw new RuntimeException($id->get_error_message());
        }
    }
    $taxonomy = wc_attribute_taxonomy_name($slug);
    if (!taxonomy_exists($taxonomy)) {
        register_taxonomy($taxonomy, ['product'], ['label' => $label]);
    }
    foreach (['TOPQA-NATURAL', 'TOPQA-SYNTHETIC'] as $index => $sku) {
        $product = wc_get_product(wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku));
        if (!$product) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Missing test product: ' . $sku);
        }
        $term = term_exists($values[$index], $taxonomy) ?: wp_insert_term($values[$index], $taxonomy);
        if (is_wp_error($term)) {
            throw new RuntimeException($term->get_error_message());
        }
        $attribute = new WC_Product_Attribute();
        $attribute->set_id($id);
        $attribute->set_name($taxonomy);
        $attribute->set_options([(int) $term['term_id']]);
        $attribute->set_visible(true);
        $attributes = $product->get_attributes();
        $attribute->set_position(count($attributes));
        $attributes[$taxonomy] = $attribute;
        $product->set_attributes($attributes);
        $product->save();
    }
}
